note: Week 1 starts on startDate (a Monday). Each week = one POC. Mon-Sat = one real milestone + one commit per day. Sunday = weekly review commit (DEVLOG + learnings).

weeks.title: Offline-first task app (Riverpod + Hive)
days: Flutter create, folder structure (data/domain/ui), add riverpod + hive
Task model + Hive adapter + repository with CRUD
Riverpod providers + list/add/complete UI
Unit tests for repository + widget test for add flow
Fake sync service with pending-changes queue and retry
README with architecture diagram, screenshots, trade-offs

days: Create-next-app, mock listings JSON data source
/listings server component with filters via searchParams

'save listing' Server Action with optimistic UI (useOptimistic)

Idempotency-Key middleware storing request hash + response
Outbox table written in same transaction as order insert
Outbox relay worker with at-least-once delivery + backoff
Concurrent duplicate requests return identical response
README with sequence diagram and failure scenarios

Producer API + worker for 'send-email' job

Per-queue rate limit + graceful shutdown on SIGTERM
Integration test for retry then DLQ path
